- Total assets acquired: $195 million (source: documents/report.md)
- Real estate investments: $162 million (source: documents/report.md)
- Notes payable and other debt: $83 million (source: documents/report.md)

The leverage of the debt to assets of Elder Trust at the time of the purchase is calculated as follows: 
Leverage = Total Liabilities Assumed / Total Assets Acquired = 85 / 195 ≈ 0.436 (or 43.6%).

All figures are from the audited 10-K and are not preliminary.
